author: Clijmart
body:
So, me and a friend were bored and made a CTF map, but later on I decided to convert it to TDM.
This is my first real TDM map ever, so suggestions are welcome.

Info:
- The map is meant to have 12 players per team at max.
- 2 Gapple and 2 Arrow spawners.
- 1 Scorebox per team, which gives 3 points.
- Point limit (Can be changed) is 100
- Lots of cover, quite a lot of ladders and hopefully a lot of fun ;)

Links:
Pics: http://imgur.com/a/Rw9VV
Download: Nopes
XML: Already made, but not putting here >:D

Extra:
I am not sure if I should make it a tournament map or not, please tell me what you think would be best.

Thanks <3
